proof_scope: Ask runs resume routes project DAG command-spec runs to Tau native command-spec resume instead of workflow-resume.

claims.proves: The public `ask runs resume <run> --json` planning surface detects a project DAG command-spec run, preserves accepted handler nodes, selects failed handler nodes plus join dependents, and emits a Tau `dag-command-spec-resume` command without executing provider work.
claims.does_not_prove: Real provider capacity, Tau execution success for a live reviewer rerun, project-watchdog reservation reattachment, or GitHub issue closure.

capability_claims.description: Ask run resume planning uses Tau's command-spec resume seam for project DAG command-spec runs.
